sloka: धर्मजजञः सत्यसन्धश्च शीलवाननसूयकः ।क्षान्तः सान्त्वयिता श्लक्ष्ह्णः कृतजञो विजितेन्द्रियः ॥२-२-३१॥
transliteration: dharmajajañaḥ satyasandhaśca śīlavānanasūyakaḥ ।kṣāntaḥ sāntvayitā ślakṣhṇaḥ kṛtajaño vijitendriyaḥ ॥2-2-31॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Rama knows the ways of righteousness. He is true to his word and free from envy. He possesses a sound character with forbearance, gentleness and a sense of gratitude. With his senses under control, he is a source of consolation (in stressful times).
